high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Indian Express," a news website. The article discusses the G-7's stance on sanctions against the Taliban if they do not honor their pledges regarding girls' education. Specifically, it mentions that the G-7 has accepted the Taliban's decree in Herat that co-education is not acceptable, even at the post-graduate level.
